chapters.title: The Arrival
chapters.description: The annual dance at the Misses Morkan's house begins. Gabriel arrives with his wife Gretta. The air is thick with anticipation and the memories of past gatherings.

chapters.title: The Dance
chapters.description: Gabriel dances with Miss Ivors and their conversation reveals his conflicted feelings about Ireland. He speaks of his love for European culture and his disconnection from his homeland.

chapters.title: The Song
chapters.description: Aunt Julia sings 'Arrayed for the Bridal' with unexpected strength. But it is another song, 'The Lass of Aughrim', that will change everything.

chapters.title: The Longing
chapters.description: Bartell D'Arcy sings 'The Lass of Aughrim'. Gretta is overcome with emotion. Gabriel watches her with growing unease.

chapters.title: The Departure
chapters.description: The party ends. The guests depart into the snow-covered night. Gabriel and Gretta make their way to the hotel, unaware of what awaits.

chapters.title: The Truth
chapters.description: In the hotel room, Gretta reveals her past. Michael Furey, a young man from Galway, had loved her deeply. He died for her, waiting in the rain.

chapters.title: The Snow
chapters.description: Gabriel watches the snow falling on Ireland, on the living and the dead. He understands at last the nature of love and loss.

chapters.title: The Dead
chapters.description: In the silence, Gabriel feels the presence of all those who have lived and died. He weeps for what he never had - and what he can never give.
